claims.claim: This is a Roadmaster sport bicycle
claims.evidence: Witness noted frame text is too small to confirm brand/model from photo 0.
Photo 0 shows a front suspension fork.
Multiple gear/shifter levers and a front derailleur are visible, but the specific 'dual series' naming/spec cannot be confirmed from the photo.
No purchase date, receipt, or age indicator is visible in the report; witness explicitly lists age/usage history as not shown.
Witness states functional condition of brakes and gears was not shown; a static photo cannot confirm operation.
Witness did not report on rust presence or absence; close-up/frame-joint detail not described.
No way to confirm part originality from a single outdoor photo; no component close-ups or markings reported.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed brand/model (Roadmaster claim could be wrong or aspirational)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of frame decal/headbadge/top-tube text in good light.

risks.risk: Gears and brakes may not function as claimed
risks.proof: Short video showing all gear shifts and both brakes being applied while wheel spins.

risks.risk: Hidden rust, dents, or frame cracks not visible in the single outdoor shot
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, underside of the bottom bracket, and dropouts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible hidden frame damage.

risks.risk: Tire tread wear or tube condition unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires including tread pattern and sidewalls.

risks.risk: Wheel trueness and bearing condition unknown
risks.proof: Video of each wheel spinning freely to check for wobble and bearing noise.

risks.risk: Age mismatch: claimed 6-month-old purchase vs actual wear/usage
risks.proof: Original purchase receipt or dated proof-of-purchase photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used bicycle of unknown age, not as near-new.

risks.risk: Frame size/fit not confirmed, may not suit buyer
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against the seat tube or stated frame size label.
risks.if_unproven: Price without a fit guarantee, generic size assumption.

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the frame decal/top-tube text showing brand and model.
Video of gear shifting through all gears and brake application with wheel spinning.
Close-up photos of frame joints, bottom bracket, and dropouts for rust/crack check.
Close-up photos of both tires showing tread and sidewall condition.
Photo of purchase receipt or any dated proof of the '6 months ago' claim.
Video of each wheel spinning to check trueness and bearing noise.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a mountain bicycle with a front suspension fork, so it can be priced as that type at worst case, with brand, condition, and age claims treated as unverified until supporting photos or video are provided.
